description: NaCrGe₂O₆ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.81 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.09 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-62°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.79 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Cr, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaCr₂Ge tetrahedra.
